topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I walked into my place after a long day, and there they were—violets, lilies, and roses, all mixed together in this beautiful bouquet. It was a bit of a mystery since there was no card. I spun around, trying to remember if I’d mentioned something to a friend or if someone I knew might have a reason to send them. But no, I couldn’t think of anything. Still, the room felt warmer, brighter, with these flowers taking center stage. I grabbed a vase, filled it with water, and carefully arranged each bloom. Whoever it was, they picked well. I can’t help but smile every time I pass by.
